scope: Current 347 visual observations, same-message no-image controls and 219 matched text-graph observations. The 617 historical dossiers are not an additional 617 scored requests.
image_budget_note: Conservative planning proxy, not a claim of identical provider tokenization. Claude 1280x800 is 46x29=1334 visual tokens; Gemini 3 high is about 1120. Validate OpenAI detail/multipliers and all provider usage before freezing.

mvp.model_coverage: All 15 distinct models in api_models and local_models, including economical-profile Sol.
mvp.sampling: Choose complete visual pairs, stratified by source, source-scale band and answer position before outputs; retain the 12 selected Part-type panels. Keep all 12 strong graph parents and select 6 degree-visible parents with anchor/change/invariance, yielding 54 unique graph observations. Audit subset priors separately; full-set shortcut bounds need not survive subsampling.
mvp.acceptance: Pipeline, format, image delivery and exploratory behavior only; not a stable ranking or a completed full-roster/full-dataset study. Selected IDs and native-input QA must be frozen before any live MVP run.

output_note: Total billed output includes hidden reasoning. 64 is a short-output cost floor, not an available no-thinking mode for every model; 2048 is a planning average, not a measurement; 8192 is an all-calls-saturate scenario, only a spend ceiling if adapters enforce a combined output cap.

collection_notes: This proposal does not edit evidence-v3's sealed three-model single-call roster.
No keys, paid inference, GPU rental, training or review invitations have been used.
A new study version must commit all models, revisions or collection-window limitations, adapters, conditions, repeats and inclusion rules before collecting responses.
All reported repeats are complete and retained. A/B calls are independent; no counterpart is sent as conversation history.
Use provider-supported generation settings; temperature zero is not universally supported or appropriate.
Main VLM results use native PNG bytes without externally supplied crops, OCR, tools or source records.
Weights use BF16/FP16 unless a separately labeled quantized configuration is explicitly committed.
The two extra configurations compare Qwen27 thinking-off/on and Gemini Pro lower/higher effort. Modes are configurations of existing models, not extra independent models.

Standard token rates, no cache or Batch discounts, no tools. Explicit cache-write fees, taxes, currency fees or regional uplifts are not itemized and must be accommodated within or added to contingency.
The cost floor and saturation scenario do not change the evaluation protocol. Choose and freeze one feasible output/effort policy before collecting any primary result.
